newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma says still holds 197 detained in crackdown.
newsitem.headline: Burma says still holds 197 detained in crackdown.

text.p: Burma said on Monday that 197 people were still being held after a crackdown in late September on supporters of pro-democracy leader Aung San Suu Kyi's National League for Democracy (NLD) party.
Burmese authorities had detained 573 people in the crackdown to thwart a planned NLD party congress.
They later released most of them. The official media said on Monday the remaining detainees were being held at government guest houses and police stations.
Police continued to man checkpoints and bar public access to University Avenue where Suu Kyi's residence is located.
The checkpoints set up on September 26 have prevented Suu Kyi from holding her regular weekend public gatherings in front of her home for two consecutive weeks.
Suu Kyi was not available for comment.
